source: app/services/recent_files_service.rb (+ Config#modify persistence, NotesService side effects, RecentFilesController) @ d47a89e92d89f807878d318182fa5dcea0329ec4
notes: Storage: a single line `recent_files = <compact JSON array of {path, opened_at}>` in <NOTES_PATH>/.fed (written via Config surgical save: replaces an existing or commented key line in place, else appends at end; whole file rewritten atomically with trailing \n). If .fed is missing it is first created from the template (shown as <FED_TEMPLATE>; text in fed_template). opened_at = Time.current.utc.iso8601(6). Time pinned with travel_to: each op runs at 2026-01-30T12:34:56.789012Z + op.at_offset seconds; entries_after is computed at now+3600s. Results: record/clear/remove/remap return Config#set result (true/false) or {error} (NotFoundError 'Note not found'). Lock file .frankmd-config.lock created in root.

cases.name: bounded (10) deduplicated most-recent-first
record on fresh notes dir creates .fed from template
record same path twice moves to front with new time
external deletion filtered without removing unrelated
file and folder mutations update shared history
rejects traversal, hidden, outside symlinks, non-markdown and malformed paths
unicode, spaces and internal symlink paths are accepted
permission errors (EACCES on stat) do not erase an entry
cases.notes: locked/ chmod 000 makes stat raise EACCES (non-root user); present? treats EACCES as present.

cases.name: malformed history JSON does not discard other configuration
